definition: Unique source registry identifier.
comparability_notes: Must trace to a registered source.

definition: Unique standardized observation identifier.
comparability_notes: Must trace to source_id and original record where possible.

definition: How the analytical value was obtained.
comparability_notes: Never mix classes silently.

definition: Publisher or responsible organization.
comparability_notes: Preserve organization exactly enough for verification.

definition: Date the evidence was retrieved.
comparability_notes: Required for web-accessed evidence.

definition: Beginning of the observation period.
comparability_notes: Do not substitute publication date.

definition: End of the observation period.
comparability_notes: Do not substitute retrieval date.

definition: Geographic coverage of the observation.
comparability_notes: National, provincial, city, zone, or other source-defined coverage.

definition: Platform represented by the observation.
comparability_notes: Multi-platform observations cannot be allocated to individual platforms without evidence.

definition: Service represented by the observation.
comparability_notes: Mixed/unknown service is not silently allocated.

definition: Vehicle universe.
comparability_notes: Primary project universe is motorcycle.

definition: Reported sample size appropriate to the measure.
comparability_notes: Retain whether n refers to drivers, trips, days, or another unit.

definition: How participants/records were recruited or sampled.
comparability_notes: Needed to assess representativeness.

definition: Fare or charge presented to the customer for the service component, excluding separately identifiable ancillary charges where possible.
comparability_notes: Not equivalent to driver gross earnings.

definition: Customer-side application/service fee separately charged to the customer.
comparability_notes: Not automatically a driver-side deduction.

definition: Other customer-side identifiable charges such as insurance or other fees.
comparability_notes: Preserve source labels/components.

definition: Driver earnings from service before driver-side deductions, excluding tips and separately identified incentives.
comparability_notes: Do not infer from customer payment unless source establishes the relationship.

definition: Amount deducted from driver gross service earnings by the platform under the source-defined basis.
comparability_notes: Must preserve deduction components when available.

definition: Other driver-side deductions not classified as platform commission.
calculation_or_basis: driver gross service earnings or documented basis
comparability_notes: Do not merge with platform commission without evidence.

definition: Platform or program incentive/bonus received by the driver.
comparability_notes: Separate from core service earnings.

definition: Voluntary customer tips received by the driver.
comparability_notes: Separate from core service earnings.

definition: Driver receipts after applicable driver-side deductions and including only explicitly identified receipt components.
comparability_notes: Calculation must preserve whether incentives/tips are included.

definition: Work-related fuel expenditure for the observation period.
comparability_notes: Observed/source-reported fuel cost is distinct from modelled fuel cost.

definition: Fuel or charging quantity attributable to work.
comparability_notes: Unit and allocation method required.

definition: Applicable fuel/charging price bound to product, period, and geography.
comparability_notes: Must not use a price from a mismatched period/product silently.

definition: Vehicle fuel efficiency used or observed.
comparability_notes: Observed, source-reported, or scenario status must be explicit.

definition: Work-related maintenance and repair cost under the source-defined period.
comparability_notes: Preserve whether routine and major maintenance are included.

definition: Work-related consumables such as tires, oil, brake components, or other source-defined consumables.
comparability_notes: Avoid duplication with maintenance if source bundles these.

definition: Work-related allocated mobile/data cost.
comparability_notes: Personal non-work share must not be assigned to driving without a method.

definition: Work-related parking and toll costs paid by the driver.
comparability_notes: Preserve reimbursement status if applicable.

definition: Other defensible work-related operating cost not captured elsewhere.
comparability_notes: Requires source label and rationale.

definition: Allocated economic depreciation of an owned vehicle for work use.
comparability_notes: Must document acquisition/value basis, useful life, residual value, and work allocation where modelled.

definition: Interest and financing fees attributable to the vehicle.
comparability_notes: Financing principal is excluded when depreciation is charged.

definition: Principal portion of vehicle financing paid in the period.
comparability_notes: Not an economic expense when depreciation is charged.

definition: Source-reported vehicle installment when principal and interest are not separable.
comparability_notes: Do not relabel as depreciation or interest.

definition: Vehicle lease/rental payment attributable to work.
comparability_notes: Do not add driver-level depreciation for the same vehicle use.

definition: Time logged in or available for app-based work.
comparability_notes: Preferred time-commitment denominator when measured.

definition: Time directly engaged in orders or source-defined productive activity.
comparability_notes: Never substitute for online hours silently.

definition: Source-reported working hours when the definition cannot be resolved further.
comparability_notes: Definition uncertainty must remain visible.

definition: Number of completed or source-defined eligible orders.
comparability_notes: Order definition and cancellations/exclusions must be documented.

definition: Distance associated with paid passenger/delivery movement.
comparability_notes: Not a proxy for total work-related distance.

definition: Distance traveled to reach the passenger/order pickup.
comparability_notes: May be unavailable.

definition: Unpaid repositioning/deadheading distance attributable to work.
comparability_notes: May be unavailable.

definition: Total driving distance attributable to work, including unpaid operating distance where measured.
comparability_notes: Preferred denominator for vehicle operating-cost allocation.

definition: Share of online/available time classified as productive under compatible definitions.
comparability_notes: Both time measures must refer to compatible period/population.

definition: Observed driver-side deduction relative to driver gross service earnings before deductions.
comparability_notes: Not calculated from customer-to-driver gap.

definition: Customer payment/charge minus driver receipt under explicitly matched transaction definitions.
calculation_or_basis: matched customer amount - matched driver receipt
comparability_notes: Not automatically platform commission.

definition: Customer-to-driver gap relative to the documented customer-side basis.
comparability_notes: Must not be labelled commission rate.

definition: Driver receipts minus documented operating cash costs and applicable vehicle cash outflows under the cash-flow treatment.
comparability_notes: Do not also deduct depreciation in the same metric.

definition: Driver receipts minus documented operating costs and economic vehicle cost under the economic-cost treatment.
calculation_or_basis: documented receipts - eligible operating costs - eligible economic vehicle cost
comparability_notes: Financing principal is excluded when depreciation is charged.

definition: Eligible net earnings divided by compatible online hours.
comparability_notes: Net basis must be identified as cash or economic.

definition: Eligible net earnings divided by compatible productive/engaged hours.
comparability_notes: Not interchangeable with online-hour earnings.

definition: Eligible net earnings divided by compatible order count.
comparability_notes: Numerator and orders must cover the same activity/period.

definition: Eligible net earnings divided by compatible work-related distance.
comparability_notes: Paid-trip km alone requires explicit caveat.

definition: Applicable regulatory fee/deduction provision and calculation basis.
comparability_notes: Must bind to legal text, scope, service, geography, and effective date.

definition: Dated government/regulator statement about implementation or enforcement status.
comparability_notes: Not equivalent to legal text or observed transaction.

definition: Dated company-stated deduction policy or implementation.
comparability_notes: Not treated as realized deduction without transaction evidence.

definition: Result of comparing applicable reference and realized evidence after scope/basis checks.
comparability_notes: Not a legal compliance determination.

definition: Original monetary value in nominal IDR for its observation period.
comparability_notes: Never overwritten by inflation adjustment.

definition: Inflation-adjusted monetary value derived with a documented price index and reference period.
comparability_notes: CPI series, geography, base/reference period, and formula required.

definition: Official or explicitly defined contextual affordability/income benchmark.
comparability_notes: Not an operating cost and not automatically a legal wage benchmark.

definition: Eligibility of an observation pair/group for the intended comparison.
comparability_notes: Assigned for a specific analytical use, not globally.
